description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the recent sequence ratio and two variables: perplexity and GPU memory ratio. The x-axis is labeled "Recent Sequence Ratio (%)", with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The left y-axis is labeled "Perplexity", with a linear scale, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1, while the right y-axis is labeled "GPU Mem. Ratio (%)", with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot contains four lines: a blue dashed line representing "Full Cache PPL" with a constant value around 4.42, an orange dashed line representing "Full Cache GPU Mem." with a constant value around 60, a blue solid line with circle markers representing "Perplexity", which starts at approximately 4.62 at 0% recent sequence ratio, decreases to around 4.3 at 50% recent sequence ratio, and then increases to about 4.65 at 100% recent sequence ratio, and an orange solid line with square markers representing "GPU Mem. Ratio", which starts at around 45 at 0% recent sequence ratio and increases to 100 at 100% recent sequence ratio.
